mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, user_name, email, phone, company_name, business_no, role, enabled, created_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, password, user_name, email, phone, company_name, business_no, role, enabled, created_at FROM users WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY user_name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, company_name = #{companyName}, business_no = #{businessNo} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
